business_summary.text: Triveni Power Transmission Limited is engaged in the power transmission business, demerged from Triveni Engineering & Industries Limited and listed on NSE and BSE in October 2026.

call_points.text: Closing order book grew by 57.2% YoY to ₹626 crores as of September 30, 2026.
EBITDA margin stood at a healthy 36.1% in Q2FY27 despite moderation from previous periods.

capital_actions.instrument: Equity shares issued for demerger consideration
capital_actions.ratio: 1 equity share of ₹2 each for every 3 equity shares of ₹1 each of TEIL

auditor_history.name: S S Kothari Mehta & Co. LLP
auditor_history.note: Limited review report with an emphasis of matter drawing attention to note 2 on the Composite Scheme of Arrangement; conclusion not modified.

auditor_history.name: S S Kothari Mehta & Co. LLP

operating_notes.text: The company operates as a single reportable segment (power transmission) with no separate segment information provided.
Capital work-in-progress rose to ₹31.28 Cr at Sep-2026 from ₹11.59 Cr at Mar-2026, indicating ongoing project execution.
The demerger of the Power Transmission Business undertaking of Triveni Engineering & Industries Limited vested in the company with effect from 1 April 2026.
Q2FY27 order booking stood at ₹126 Cr (+47.7% YoY) and H1FY27 order booking at ₹330 Cr (+94.7% YoY).

timeline.summary: Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹116.16 Cr, net profit ₹26.06 Cr.
On October 23, 2026, Triveni Power Transmission reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹116.16 Cr and net profit of ₹26.06 Cr.
Triveni Power Transmission reported maiden Q2FY27 results with revenue of ₹116.16 Cr and net profit of ₹26.06 Cr post-listing.
